name: Jannai
title: Ancestor of Jesus in Luke's genealogy
summary: Jannai is a person mentioned in the genealogy of Jesus in the Gospel of Luke, chapter 3. He is listed as the son of Joseph and the father of Melki in the genealogical line that traces Jesus' ancestry back to Adam. Very little is known about him beyond his place in the family tree.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Jesus' genealogy
keyEvents.description: Jannai is listed in Luke's genealogy as one of Jesus' ancestors. He is mentioned between Melki (his son) and Joseph (his father) in the descending line from God through Adam to Jesus.

keyEvents.title: A link in salvation history
keyEvents.description: Although little is known about Jannai personally, he serves as an important link in the genealogical chain that connects Jesus with the entire history of humanity back to Adam and God.

keyEvents.title: Part of the intertestamental period
keyEvents.description: Jannai likely lived during the intertestamental period between the Old and New Testaments, a time when God's people were waiting for the promised Messiah.

keyEvents.title: God's Faithfulness Through the Generations
keyEvents.description: Janna's place in the genealogy testifies to God's faithful plan through countless generations to fulfill the promise of a Savior, as promised to Abraham and David.
